Using the integrated Clausius–Clapeyron equation,

\[
\ln\left(\frac{p_2^*}{p_1^*}\right)
=\frac{\Delta_{\mathrm{vap}}H^\circ}{R}
\left(\frac{1}{T_1}-\frac{1}{T_2}\right),
\]

with \(\Delta_{\mathrm{vap}}H^\circ(\mathrm{H_2O})\approx 44.0\ \mathrm{kJ\,mol^{-1}}\),

\[
\ln\left(\frac{p_2^*}{p_1^*}\right)
=\frac{44\,000}{8.314}
\left(\frac1{290}-\frac1{292}\right)
\approx 0.125.
\]

Hence,

\[
\frac{p_2^*}{p_1^*}=e^{0.125}\approx 1.133,
\]

so the relative increase is approximately

\[
(1.133-1)\times 100\%\approx 13\%.
\]

\[
\boxed{13}
